description: Executes a tool call within an active session against a simulated backend. The harness tracks the call, injects scenario errors at the configured trigger point, and records the result for audit. Reads return a generic ok without data.

arguments.description: Arguments the agent passes to the tool.

session_id.description: Active session ID (the UUID returned by start_session).

tool_name.description: Name of the tool the agent is calling.

name: execute_call
title: Execute Tracked Call
